## Workload

Daniel Roche completed 779 reads during the quarter, recording 402 hours of work. This represents an average of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the recorded hours and overall reading activity. The results provide a clear summary of throughput for the period and support comparison with the quality findings below.

## Quality

A sample of 72 reads was checked. Agreement was 73.6 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with the review focusing on the consistency of reading decisions and the application of relevant criteria. The findings should be considered alongside the workload information, as both measures provide context for the assessment.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
